regions.original:
危険！
使用禁止
近づかないで！
regions.translation:
Danger!
Do not use!
Do not approach!
regions.breakdown: 危険 (kiken): danger. 使用禁止 (shiyō kinshi): use prohibited / no entry. 近づかないで (chikazukanai de): Do not approach (近づく chikazuku: to approach; -ないで -nai de: negative imperative).
郵便 (yūbin): mail, postal service. POST: English loanword for post.
日本 (Nihon): Japan. 郵便 (yūbin): mail, postal service.
誠心堂 (Seishindō): Name of the pharmacy. 談薬局 (dan yakkyoku): Consultation pharmacy (談 dan: talk/consultation; 薬局 yakkyoku: pharmacy).

where_youd_see_it: On a red Japanese post box on a street or sidewalk, with a nearby pharmacy sign.
cultural_note: Japanese post boxes are typically red and prominently feature the '〒' (te-mark) symbol, which is the official postal mark. The warning notice indicates that this particular post box is temporarily out of service or damaged.
